comments.content: Removing std::forward<Args>(args)... breaks perfect forwarding for the variadic call. The template is intended to forward Args&&... args to the callable f; using args... passes lvalues and loses rvalue categories, which can cause copies and break move-only arguments. Revert to (*f)(obj, sub.c_str(), std::forward<Args>(args)...).

Returning from tryModifyMenuBar when item == menuBar aborts the whole modification loop. The self-removal guard should skip only the offending entry and continue processing remaining removals, e.g. continue instead of return.

Same early-return issue in tryModifyToolBar: returning when item == toolBar stops processing of subsequent toolbar removals. Skip the single self-removal instead of returning to avoid silently ignoring later modifications.
